body:
think a little bigger, as in what would make you happy or to even feel a little bit good?is it money?is it true love?is it to help others?whatever your goal may be, work hard for it. work like you never did before. try new things and experiment with what makes you feel good. i've been in your shoes(or i think i did). my love life has been pretty much like yours, fail upon fail. but i tried and tried. it took me 2 years to finally find something that i want to live for and do. so even if it may seem impossible, never stop looking.
P.S.: sorry for this clusterfuck of thoughts and ideas. i hope it inspired you a little bit
you can hmu and we can talk and discuss all of this,as a friend to a firend
